profile.name: Sensirion 传感器桥 I2C 设备接口
profile.name_en: Sensirion Sensor Bridge I2C Device Interface
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件控制组件，用于表示通过 Sensirion Sensor Bridge 连接的通用 I2C 外设，而不是某一台特定的独立仪器。它在实验中用于设置目标 I2C 地址、控制桥接口对外设的供电、输出连接信息，并在使用结束后关闭通信会话。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software control component representing a generic I2C peripheral connected through a Sensirion Sensor Bridge, rather than a specific standalone instrument. In laboratory use, it is used to set the target I2C address, control bridge power to the peripheral, print connection information, and close the communication session when finished.

registry.name: Sensirion AG Sensirion Bridge I2 C
registry.description: Sensirion Bridge I2 C Device是由Sensirion AG生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、初始化。支持Signal, Slot, power off等操作。
